title: Jimmy Kimmel Returns to ‘The Howard Stern Show’
summary: This week, Jimmy Kimmel Live! is broadcasting from the Brooklyn Academy of Music (BAM) in New York City.
body_markdown:
On Monday, September 28,[Jimmy Kimmel](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/jimmy-kimmel) returns *The Howard Stern Show* . Listen to the show on satellite channel 100 and[on the SiriusXM app.](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-HowardStern)


[The Howard Stern Show Howard’s interviews, bits, and more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-HowardStern)


This week, *Jimmy Kimmel Live!* is broadcasting from the Brooklyn Academy of Music (BAM) in New York City.


[Howard Stern](https://www.siriusxm.com/talk/howard-stern) is best known for his deep, wide-ranging long-form discussions with iconic figures across music, comedy, entertainment and beyond. Howard’s legendary interview, comedy and entertainment radio show, “The Howard Stern Show,” airs exclusively on SiriusXM, where Howard has produced two channels of new and classic shows since 2006.


Listen to Howard’s exclusive SiriusXM channel –[Howard 100 (Ch. 100)](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/howard-100) – anytime in the car and on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-HowardStern) .
